messages.subject: Project Indigo - IP ownership & encumbrance review
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor, Priya,

Attached is our IP ownership and encumbrance review of the Helios family. Headlines: title is clean (the CNIPA recordal gap has been corrected); the only existing licence is the non-commercial Cambridge research licence, which doesn't touch the field of use; two matters to disclose - the EP3712889 Art.94(3) objection and third-party US10,114,202, on which Hartington's FTO is favourable.

Happy to talk it through.

Regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
